audit.why: Naafiri favoured every stage — Hwei has no dash and a slow cast pattern; both layers and the packet agree (Naafiri all 7 rows). No chart edits.

Spikes all present and mechanically sound: 3-5 gap-close through telegraphs, 6 all-in when his W-palette peel is burnt, first-item one-rotation, late W onto backline. Fabricated spell names inside them fixed under point 4.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fabricated ability names shipped across both layers: 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' — Hwei's CC palette is Subject: Torment (E); 'EW-Pool of Shadows' — the real spell is Pool of Reflection on the W palette (WW); 'E-Stirring Lights' is WE (W palette, not E). Also 'W-Hound's Pursuit' vs the real Hounds' Pursuit (apostrophe). Cooldowns field had no digits; two bullets were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad.
audit.why: Riot kit text: E is Subject: Torment (12s, the CC palette — Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss, Crushing Maw); W is Subject: Serenity (18s — Fleeting Current, Pool of Reflection, Stirring Lights); Q is Subject: Disaster (10s), R Spiraling Despair (120s). Every projectile-flagged paint can be body-blocked by the pack/minions.
audit.corrected: All fabricated names replaced with kit names; real cooldowns added.
